summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), tests/test_progress.py (new tests before the script-entry block, plus aliased imports), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet linking PR 1759).
